component: Folder Properties Fluent placeholders and runtime values

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The migrated count and size labels carry Fluent IDs for unknown values. The existing loader separately assigns a nonnegative message count and a formatted disk size to those same .value properties. These are separate localization and data-loading roles. Source inspection alone does not establish retranslation timing or the final rendered value; preserve both consumers when changing these fields.
title: Folder Properties separates localized unknown values from loaded folder data
